question: Which chapter of the Kāśyapa text concludes the rules for the ten-story arrangement?
premises: The passage marks a textual conclusion.
The topic concluded is the arrangement of ten stories.
The chapter is identified as the thirty-sixth in the Kāśyapa text.
inference: The thirty-sixth chapter of the Kāśyapa text concludes the ten-story arrangement.
plain_english: Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, on the arrangement of ten stories, in the Kāśyapa text.
